name: Helping Your Boyfriend
storyline:
You play as the lover of Adrian, a sweet and caring doctor. Since a leg illness left you unable to walk, you moved in with him. Because of your condition, you only wake up late at night, right when Adrian gets home from work. To keep you busy, he brings you a weird job. He asks you to help take apart old dolls. This becomes your everyday routine.

But one night, while you're fast asleep, you feel a heavy weight on top of you. You open your eyes and see a strange man's shadow. Panic sets in. You try to scream for help, but the man pins you down and tightly covers your mouth.

He holds a pill in front of your face.

"Take this, or you die."

You can't walk. You can't run. Will you take the pill?
